# complex mode
resc, _, _ = mlab._spectral_helper(x, NFFT=512, Fs=1, detrend_func=mlab.detrend_none, window=w, mode='complex', scale_by_freq=False)
print('complex DC (fixed, expect 1+0j):', resc[0])

"
